title: Applications/solution Architect
description:
Application Architect

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metro area looking to add an Application Architect to their team. This role combines practical development responsibilities with strategic solution architecture, focusing primarily on hands-on application design, development, and delivery, while providing guidance on broader solution architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead design, development, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and maintainable applications across web, mobile, and emerging technologies.
  • Serve as a hands-on full-stack C# developer using Microsoft technologies including .Net Core, .Net Framework, Web API, ASP.Net, MVC, and related frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain clean, testable, and high-quality code; create unit tests and enforce coding best practices.
  • Create and present technical roadmaps and solution designs to stakeholders and development teams.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements while maintaining a security-first mindset.
  • Mentor and lead team members, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and a "get things done” attitude.
  • Evaluate new technologies and frameworks, making recommendations to improve system performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Apply Solution Architect principles to design end-to-end systems, integrating across multiple platforms and services, while remaining actively involved in development.
  • Work in Agile environments, utilizing DevOps practices and cloud-based platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure) for CI/CD and deployments.

Qualifications:

  • 8-10 years of software development experience with hands-on technical leadership.
  • 2+ years of experience developing technical roadmaps and presenting architectural solutions.
  • Strong experience with full-stack C# development, Web API, and front-end frameworks (e.g., Vue.js or other JavaScript frameworks).
  • Deep relational database expertise (SQL Server), including writing queries, stored procedures, DDL, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with web services, SOA, ETL, XML/XSL, and both relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with creativity, initiative, and customer focus.
  • Experience leading teams to deliver complex, scalable, and highly available solutions.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and influence skills.
  • Security-first mindset and understanding of best practices for protecting sensitive data.
  • Experience with Octopus Deploy, PowerShell, and emerging front-end technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native development, particularly on Microsoft Azure including GitHub Enterprise and GitActions.
  • Knowledge of software design patterns, microservices architecture, and modern DevOps practices.

title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
Service Desk Analyst

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in Broomfield, CO looking to add a Service Desk Analyst to their team. The role is a contract, hybrid position. The Service Desk Analyst is a member of the Global IT Service Desk Team that supports all employees and contractors in corporate, retail stores, and distribution centers.

This role is the first point of contact for users needing assistance. The analyst will respond to incidents and requests reported by users, delivering the highest level of customer service.

Must possess strong interpersonal attributes, a collaborative mindset, good judgment, clear communication skills, and the desire to help others.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide superior Customer Service and IT Support
  • Field tickets, support calls, chats, and emails from users inquiring about software, hardware, connectivity, or similar issues.
  • Follow all established support procedures and participate in the creation of new procedures for the team and end users.
  • Provide accurate, timely, and creative solutions to end-users
  • Escalate more complex problems to higher level support staff.
  • Troubleshoot and provide support of retail and operations systems

Personal traits:

  • Highly motivated self-starter with a "Sense of Urgency”
  • Prioritize and execute multiple initiatives in a collaborative and fast-paced environment
  • Maintain high level of confidentiality

Customer Service skills:

  • Empathy for the customer
  • Problem-solving
  • Clear communication

IT Basics Knowledge:

  • PC hardware, software, and peripherals
  • Networking technologies (VPN/VLAN/WIFI)
  • Active Directory

Minimum Experience

  • 1 year of IT Support or Helpdesk experience. Strong Customer Service and relevant certifications

title: Senior Mechanical Estimator
description:
Senior Mechanical Estimator

GavinHeath is partnering with a leading industrial‐construction firm to recruit a full-time Senior Mechanical Estimator. This role will begin with an on-site immersion—three months in one of our partner's regional offices (Westminster, CO).

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the complete pre-construction estimating process for jobs up to $25 million, spanning process piping, structural steel, equipment setting and civil scopes.
  • Review bid documents and drawings, attend pre-bid meetings and develop detailed opportunity matrices.
  • Conduct or validate quantity take-offs, assign labor, equipment and material rates, and enter all data into HCSS HeavyBid (or a comparable estimating platform).
  • Issue, track and resolve RFIs; solicit at least three competitive quotes per trade or material from vendors and subcontractors; negotiate pricing and terms.
  • Build cash-flow tables, resource-loaded schedules in Microsoft Project or Primavera P6, and thorough risk-analysis reports.
  • Lead internal bid-review sessions, compile exceptions and clarifications, prepare submittals, and deliver turnkey turnover packages to field teams.
  • Mentor junior estimators—review their take-offs, share best practices and continuously improve pre-construction workflows.

What You'll Bring

  • Five to ten years' industrial-construction estimating experience, or a bachelor's in Construction Management or Mechanical Engineering plus at least two years of relevant estimating.
  • Hands-on proficiency with HCSS HeavyBid (or similar), advanced Excel modeling, and scheduling tools (MS Project or Primavera P6).
  • Deep familiarity with process-piping materials and welding procedures (stainless, chrome, Inconel, Hastelloy, HDPE, PVC/CPVC), as well as structural-steel erection and mechanical equipment installation.
  • A clean driver's license (age 21+ to operate company vehicles) and the flexibility to be on-site for the initial ramp-up period.
  • Preferred: Prior field experience as a pipefitter, welder or field engineer, and background in a self-perform general-contractor or EPC environment.
  • Preferred: Working knowledge of ASME R-Stamp/U-Stamp and AISC steel-erection standards.

Why This Opportunity Matters
At GavinHeath's partner, you'll be empowered to shape the estimating process end-to-end, influence project profitability and work alongside senior pre-construction and operations leaders. After your foundational on-site phase, you'll enjoy a flexible work arrangement while continuing to drive accuracy, efficiency and margin protection on a diverse portfolio of industrial projects.

title: Inside Account Representative — Inside Sales
description:
Inside Account Representative — Inside Sales

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in the IT solutions industry, looking to add an Inside Account Representative — Inside Sales to their team. The role is a Full-Time position with remote flexibility.
Responsibilities
  • Support Military account growth by managing high-volume, lower-complexity run-rate requests.
  • Build and maintain accurate quotes, bills of materials, and order submissions with strong attention to detail.
  • Ensure zero missed deal registrations or expirations by proactively tracking deadlines.
  • Maintain CRM accuracy and completeness to support audit readiness and prevent downstream errors.
  • Respond to all customer requests within SLA standards, ensuring no customer goes unanswered.
  • Collaborate closely with the Inside Account Manager and Sales Executive to align priorities and support account strategy.
  • Partner with OEMs and distributors to manage pricing, markups, and deal registration processes.
  • Demonstrate consistent growth and ownership with the goal of promotion to Inside Account Manager within approximately two years.
Qualifications
Required:
  • Strong proficiency in Excel (lookups, pivot tables, multi-sheet management, error checking).
  • Experience in sales operations such as quoting, order entry, and CRM record management.
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to custom CRM tools.
  • Strong communication skills: direct, concise, and resilient under pressure.
  • Comfortable in a junior support role, working closely with senior team members.
Preferred:
  • Inside sales, VAR, or distributor experience.
  • Prior exposure to federal or DoD sales environments (Army/Navy/etc. account knowledge a plus).
  • Experience coordinating with OEMs and distributors on pricing and deal registrations.
  • Resilient personality: able to reset quickly after setbacks and thrive in a fast-paced, detail-driven environment.
Compensation and Logistics
  • Salary: $50,000 base
  • Work Arrangement: Remote-friendly, with flexible hours and outcome-driven expectations. Occasional late hours may be required to meet deadlines.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, vision, PTO, and retirement benefits. Commission plan eligibility after promotion.

title: Sales Associate
description:
Sales Associate

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in Centennial, CO looking to add a Sales Associate to their team. The role is a FTE position.

Responsibilities

  • Make 150+ outbound cold calls daily to potential customers to gather information and qualify leads for senior sales representatives
  • Deliver outstanding customer service while representing the brand with energy, professionalism, and integrity
  • Handle frequent rejection with resilience and stay focused on individual and team performance metrics
  • Complete a structured 90-day training program with defined benchmarks and consistent feedback
  • Apply scripts, call guides, and coaching during ramp-up, evolving into independent ownership of your sales approach
  • Participate in ongoing training and performance reviews to continually improve skills and outcomes
  • Maintain strong punctuality, stay focused, and maximize productivity throughout the workday — distraction-free (no excessive phone use, idle time, or disengagement)
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment with daily, weekly, and monthly goals

Qualifications

  • Recent college graduate or early-career professional (1–2 prior roles)
  • Competitive drive, strong discipline, and a performance mindset — whether developed through sports, academics, work, the arts, or other pursuits
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a commitment to delivering value to customers
  • Comfortable with repetition, direct outreach, and high-volume activity
  • Highly coachable, dependable, and eager to grow in a team-oriented environment
  • Able to work on-site 4 days a week
  • Must live within a reasonable commute of the Denver Tech Center (DTC) or Castle Rock
  • Preferred:
  • Insurance Licensing (Property & Casualty, Life & Health). NOTE: for candidates who are not licensed, our client will reimburse the cost of licensing after 90 days of employment. Client will additionally provide study time during the first two weeks of employment.
